description: If our economy runs on someone’s labor, then our policies should make sure that labor buys something back— stability, dignity, and a real path to a decent life. That is the center of how I think about the economy. Growth that looks good on a spreadsheet while leaving working people exhausted, insecure, and one emergency away from collapse is not success. title: Labor, cost of living, and economic fairness
